pages.content:
# MCP Gateway

MCP Gateway exposes model-context tools to internal applications. Before a tool session is opened, the gateway authenticates the caller through Auth Service.

## Authentication migration status

As of 2026-09-12, MCP Gateway consumes Auth API v2 and calls POST /v2/auth. The Auth API v1 dependency is retired and MCP no longer calls POST /v1/auth. MCP-150 records completion of the migration.

This statement was written from the migration review. The current Bitbucket production-branch snapshot has not yet been checked against it.
